# B494 row (f): StoreLimits above the pod memory limit; who fires first
confined: yes (native pods, uid 250); profile file not readable without sudo.
The node's sampler (runtimed pkg/supervisor/sampler.go) polls ri_phys_footprint at 1 Hz and fires after DefaultBreachSamples=3
consecutive over-limit samples, so it acts ~2-3 s after a breach. The guest grows 16 MiB every 250 ms (64 MiB/s), touching every
16 KiB page so the growth is resident footprint.

## verdict
PASS with a margin condition. With StoreLimits well above the limit (1024 MiB vs 128Mi) the footprint sampler fired first:
'pod exceeded memory limit; OOMKilling' at footprint 291521448 B (2.17x the limit, ~2.6 s after the breach) and the container
reports reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, signal 9. The 512Mi contrast held 160 MiB of guest memory for 30 s and completed (exit 0).
But at 1.5x (192 MiB) the guest's memory.grow was refused by StoreLimits first (exit 5, no OOMKilled): the sampler's ~3 s
detection window lets a 64 MiB/s guest overshoot the limit by ~2x before the kill, so 'StoreLimits above the limit' must leave
headroom of at least growth-rate x 3 s (or be pinned far above, e.g. node memory) to stay a backstop rather than the first to fire.
